messages.subject: Spammer idiots
parts:
Dear all,

the hmecology mailing list seems to have become invaded by some idiots ....

I am a little disappointed by Google: I would have thought that they have better spam filters on their mailing lists ! Anybody an idea what we could do ?

Thanks and best regards  --- Marc

-Alex
